src/agent_runtime/mentions.py

Python · Tier A

Keep browser shortcuts and server parameter parsing on one namespace/literal grammar. registry_payload supplies composer metadata; normalization and reservation prevent saved parameters from shadowing actions. without_literals masks code/escaped mentions without moving offsets, and parameter_mentions yields valid tokens without reading a parameter store.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
normalize_parameter_key 103 Canonicalize an optional key for Parameter Store identity and namespace reservation: collapse whitespace, lowercase, map unsupported characters to underscores and strip edge separators. This does not look up aliases or validate a stored record.
is_reserved 120 Check the normalized key against namespace IDs/aliases and special/mode action IDs so saved parameters cannot shadow composer controls.
registry_payload 126 Return authoritative namespace/action metadata and browser grammar patterns for the registry API. The payload contains no parameter values, attachment metadata or per-editor state.
without_literals 140 Replace fenced code, inline code and escaped mentions with equal-length spaces. Translate the shared JavaScript any-character class for Python while retaining every original token offset.
parameter_mentions 145 Yield exact valid Parameter Store tokens using the shared literal/namespace grammar. Like admission's parse_references, diagnostics ignore invalid tokens. This helper preserves token spelling and never resolves a store entry.
